summary: Reviewed 11 units. Total issues: 3 error, 20 minor (about 21 carry a machine patch). Errors: unit 3 Hindi adds 'होता'; unit 5 Hindi invents 'होमों से'; unit 6 Hindi 'सुदोह्य' is passive for active sudughe. Recurring minor problems: bracketed interpretations carried into Hindi, English or gloss (vanaspati = post, cord, यूप, स्तुतियों), svadhā rendered inconsistently (unit 8 'own power', unit 11 'nature'), unit 4 gram (acc.) contradicts the vocative translation, and unit 3 confidence too high. No text_flags needed (no typos found in the printed lines). No regrouping suggested. Glossary additions proposed: Vasus = Vasus (वसु); Ādityas = Ādityas (आदित्य); barhis = barhis (बर्हि), sacred grass; svadhā = own power (स्वधा); dhī = thought (धी); apas = work(s) (कार्य, not कर्म); vanaspati = Lord of the Forest (no identification in the translation); śamitṛ = Śamitṛ (शमिता); su-vīra = rich in heroes (Hindi: उत्तम वीरों से युक्त, not the bare 'सुवीर'); svāhā = svāhā (स्वाहा); viśve devāḥ = all gods (सब देव); varṇa = colour (kind).
